name: Discovery & Planning
summary: Not sure where to start, or have an idea that needs to be shaped into a practical solution? We work with you to understand the problem, define what needs to be built, identify the right technology and approach, and create a clear plan for execution. This is ideal for larger or more complex projects where getting the direction right before development can save time and cost.
terms: Typically 1–2 weeks, priced according to project requirements.

name: Build & Deliver
summary: From a small task that simply needs to get done to a complete software, AI automation, or data analytics solution, we build what your business needs and take it through to delivery. We work in clear phases with defined deliverables, keeping you involved throughout development while handling the technical work from start to finish. This is the right fit when you have a project that needs to be built, improved, automated, or brought to life.
terms: Priced per project, with larger engagements structured into clear delivery phases.

name: Ongoing Support
summary: Some solutions need more than a one-time delivery. We stay involved to maintain, improve, monitor, automate, and support your digital systems over time, whether that means ongoing software development, AI automation, data analytics, digital marketing, or operational support. This is ideal for businesses that need a reliable technology partner without building a full in-house team.
terms: Monthly retainer, with scope and support level agreed based on ongoing requirements.
